## Main Results

### REPLICATE TABLE 1: Validation of automated classification against human coding

```{r table-1}
labels <- read.csv("data/table_01_labels.csv")
variables <- c("coercive_coder1", "administrative_coder1",
               "coercive_coder2", "administrative_coder2",
               "coercive_qwen", "administrative_qwen")
stopifnot(nrow(labels) == 200L, all(variables %in% names(labels)))

cohen <- function(x, y) {
  complete <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  x <- x[complete]
  y <- y[complete]
  observed <- mean(x == y)
  expected <- mean(x == 1) * mean(y == 1) +
    mean(x == 0) * mean(y == 0)
  c(kappa = (observed - expected) / (1 - expected),
    agreement = 100 * observed)
}

pairs <- data.frame(
  Label = rep(c("Coercive", "Administrative"), each = 3),
  `Rater pair` = rep(c("Coder 1 vs. Coder 2", "Coder 1 vs. Qwen3-Max",
                       "Coder 2 vs. Qwen3-Max"), 2),
  left = c("coercive_coder1", "coercive_coder1", "coercive_coder2",
           "administrative_coder1", "administrative_coder1",
           "administrative_coder2"),
  right = c("coercive_coder2", "coercive_qwen", "coercive_qwen",
            "administrative_coder2", "administrative_qwen",
            "administrative_qwen"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
values <- t(vapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
  cohen(labels[[pairs$left[i]]], labels[[pairs$right[i]]])
}, numeric(2)))

kappa_4dp <- as.numeric(sprintf("%.4f", values[, "kappa"]))
table_1 <- data.frame(
  Label = pairs$Label,
  `Rater pair` = pairs[["Rater pair"]],
  `Cohen's kappa` = sprintf("%.3f", floor(kappa_4dp * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000),
  `Simple agreement` = sprintf("%.2f%%", values[, "agreement"]),
  check.names = FALSE
)

dir.create("Figures_Tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
tex_agreement <- paste0(sub("%$", "", table_1[["Simple agreement"]]), "\\%")
tex_rows <- sprintf("%s & %s & %s & %s \\\\",
                    table_1$Label, table_1[["Rater pair"]],
                    table_1[["Cohen's kappa"]], tex_agreement)
writeLines(c(
  "\\begin{table}[htbp]",
  "\\centering",
  "\\small",
  "\\caption{Validation of automated classification against human coding}",
  "\\label{tab:main-validation}",
  "\\begin{tabular}{llcc}",
  "\\toprule",
  "Label & Rater pair & Cohen's $\\kappa$ & Simple agreement \\\\",
  "\\midrule",
  tex_rows[1:3],
  "\\addlinespace",
  tex_rows[4:6],
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}",
  "\\end{table}"
), "Figures_Tables/Table_1.tex")
knitr::kable(table_1)
```

The resulting file is [Table 1](Figures_Tables/Table_1.tex).

### Generate remaining analytical tables and figures

```{r run-analysis}
source("code/run_analysis.R")
generated <- run_analysis()
cat("Generated", length(generated), "additional tables and figures.\n")
```

```{r display-functions, include=FALSE}
show_figure <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path("Figures_Tables", name)
  stopifnot(file.exists(path))
  cat(sprintf('<p><a href="%s">%s</a></p>\n', path, name))
  cat(sprintf('<object data="%s" type="application/pdf" width="100%%" height="560px"></object>\n',
              path))
}
show_table <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path("Figures_Tables", name)
  stopifnot(file.exists(path))
  cat(sprintf('<p><a href="%s">%s</a></p>\n', path, name))
}
```
